notes: The two marginal notes ('Or, still is my prayer against their wickedness', 'Or, calamities') were read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).

The italicized 'it shall be' twice divides into an added referential 'it' and a construction-supplied copula joining the nominal predicate (rule 20); a competing reading takes all three words as one added frame, but that would leave the verbless clauses' copula unaccounted.

Materially different reading available at s015/s016: 'even' could be taken as the rendering of עוֹד and 'shall ... continue' as a supplied lexical verb, but that leaves the waw unrendered and supplies a predicate no morpheme carries, so the division above was preferred; rule 20 already reads עוֹד as an anchor bearing such a frame.

Competing reading on the supplied 'it' at t029: it could be read as a second realization of שֶׁמֶן under rule 25's resumption sentences. It is left added because rule 44 governs a pronoun the ASV supplies as the object of a verb whose Hebrew clause writes none, while rule 25's resumption paragraphs place a pronoun supplied as the subject of a clause that has none.
